answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring every new identity to lock a refundable bond equal to the median peer stake, then wait through a multi-day unbonding window where a proven clone is slashed. A cartographer logging routes from a desert canyon, attaching cedar-grain provenance photos, and posting fees into a quartz-denominated escrow still cannot cheaply mint sockpuppets, because each extra name repeats the same lock, delay, and slash risk.
